subject: Pilot success metrics alignment and kickoff prep — Paragon BI
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Lucas Moreno <lucas@paragonbi.com>, Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@paragonbi.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 14:03:00 +0000
Subject: Follow-up + pilot scope summary from today's discovery

Hi Lucas / Priya —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap so we have shared alignment and clear next steps for a short pilot (4–6 weeks) focused on entity extraction + data enrichment for your analytics pipelines. Key points below — please call out anything I missed.

Primary pain / goal:
- Paragon has inconsistent entity extraction across invoices and purchase orders (variants in vendor names and SKUs). You want a 30% reduction in manual labeling and a measurable lift in normalized vendor matching accuracy within the pilot window.

Success metrics (proposed):
- Precision/recall on vendor extraction: target >= 0.88 F1 for pilot data slice A (invoices).
- End-to-end latency for batch enrichment: < 300ms per record at target batch size (10k/day).
- Operational: integrated S3 ingest + Redwood inference with automated KV caching.

Scope we discussed:
- 4-week technical pilot with two phases: (1) prompt/eval tuning (week 1–2) and (2) integrated run + QA (week 3–4).
- Prompt evaluation set: 600 labeled examples (samples you can provide) + 1k unlabeled samples for live inference testing.
- Owners: Lucas (data owner / S3 access), Priya (business success / acceptance), Redwood: Ben (AE), Stephanie (Solutions lead), Monica (Customer Success/ops once launched).

Access & security checklist (what we need to start):
- S3 read-only path for sample dataset (pointer or pre-signed URLs).
- A stub account or API key for sandbox usage, plus any IP allowlist requirements.
- Confirmation on data retention policy for pilot logs (default Redwood pilot retention is 30 days unless you request otherwise).

Attachments I uploaded for reference: mutual action plan (MAP) + a sample prompt eval file (see attachments).

Suggested next steps:
1) Lucas: share access to sample S3 and a small labeled set (200 rows) by EOD Mon 7/31.
2) Redwood: Ben & I will draft a compact MAP and schedule a 30-min kickoff with engineering (Mon/Tue next week).
3) Priya: confirm acceptance criteria or add any business KPIs I missed.

If that matches your view, I can circulate the MAP and a calendar invite for kickoff.

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Stephanie Nguyen
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: Paragon_Pilot_MAP_v1.xlsx (xlsx), prompt-eval-sample.jsonl)

From: Lucas Moreno <lucas@paragonbi.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@paragonbi.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 15:20:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Follow-up + pilot scope summary from today's discovery

Thanks Stephanie — this is great and captures the call well. Quick clarifications:

- Confirmed: we'll prioritize invoices first (vendor name normalization) and then PO SKU mapping if we have headroom.
- I'll share a pre-signed S3 folder with 250 labeled invoice rows + 1k unlabeled examples by EOD Mon (S3 link will be shared with your secure-ops email).
- Data retention: we'll default to 30 days; I'll confirm with our security team if we need a shorter window but low likelihood.

Two asks from our side:
1) Can you include an extra metric for deduplication rate post-normalization? That is important for downstream deduped-revenue reporting.
2) We may need a short runbook for how Redwood's KV cache interacts with our batched job (we run nightly batches).

If you can get the kickoff invite for Tue 8/3 16:00 PT (we're in PT), that works for Priya and me.

Appreciate it — looking forward to the MAP.

Best,
Lucas
Head of Data & Integrations | Paragon BI
lucas@paragonbi.com
(Attachment: none)

Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 09:10:00 +0000
Subject: Pilot MAP + kickoff invite (Tue 8/3 16:00 PT)

Lucas / Priya —

Thanks for the quick confirmation. I updated the MAP to include the deduplication KPI and a short note on KV cache behavior for nightly batches (see section 3). I've attached the MAP and a prompt-eval sample file for your review. Highlights:

- Kickoff: Tue 3 Aug 2027, 16:00 PT (calendar invite sent).
- Owners: Lucas (data + env access), Priya (business acceptance), Monica (CS lead for operations), Ben (AE), Stephanie ( solutions lead / primary contact).
- Pilot timeline: week 0: access + baseline run; week 1: prompt tuning & evals (600 labeled target); week 2–3: integration + parallel runs; week 4: acceptance & handoff notes.
- Acceptance criteria (concrete): vendor F1 >= 0.88 on held-out invoice set AND deduplication rate improvement >= 20% vs baseline.
- Prompt evals: attached JSONL is a starting seed; we'll iterate 2–3 prompt variants during week 1 and track scoring in the shared Drive sheet.

Access/setup notes (action items):
- Lucas: S3 pre-signed folder + sample schema doc (due Mon 7/31).
- Redwood (Ben/Stephanie): will provision a sandbox API key and share IP allowlist steps by Mon 7/31.
- Monica: please prepare a short onboarding runbook (internal) and share required support hours estimates for the pilot.

If this all looks correct, we'll treat those items as the kickoff-deck checklist. I also pasted a compact checklist below so it's easy to copy into your tracker.

Compact checklist (copyable):
- [ ] S3 access: pre-signed folder & schema (Lucas, 7/31)
- [ ] Labeled seed: 250 rows (Lucas, 7/31)
- [ ] Redwood sandbox API key & allowlist (Redwood, 7/31)
- [ ] MAP review & sign-off (Priya, 8/2)
- [ ] Kickoff call (8/3 16:00 PT)

Looking forward to kickoff.

—
Stephanie Nguyen
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
(Attachments: Paragon_Pilot_MAP_v1.xlsx, prompt-eval-sample.jsonl)
